catalog_coverage.why: No other prompt asks Claude to update an existing file without a clear preservation boundary.
Claude performs the evidence read or artifact check; the student is not assigned manual correctness proofreading.
The prompt either has no stance-softening regeneration or explicitly asks for harsh, edge-preserving evidence.
No prompt asks Claude to interview the student through a sequence of questions.
The prompt either creates a fresh artifact or explicitly names the destination and in-place overwrite behavior.
The multi-step prompt shape meets the catalog trigger; surrounding no-preamble language mitigates but does not erase the residual.
No unbounded add/regenerate instruction remains; integration or first-create intent is explicit where needed.
No prompt invokes plan mode or asks for a plan artifact for approval.
No prompt requests a body of sourced factual claims with an unscoped cite-or-flag rule.
Reports are constrained by concrete artifacts, quoted changes, or evidence-backed debrief requirements.
No offered default or candidate structure invites uncritical acceptance.
No plan-mode plan is produced for student approval.
No heterogeneous source-ingestion task requires source-type or extraction-depth classification.
No citations are requested without a sentence-level support check.
Evidence-backed debrief carve-outs, harsh instructions, or independent cold reads prevent an unsupported charitable self-critique.
